jsch generate --schema https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema --overrides overrides.json --out ./model --package model --type Root

exec go vet ./model
exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- overrides.json --
{
  "refs": {
    "#": {
      "goIdent": "Schema",
      "goAdditionalFields": [
        {"goIdent": "resolved", "goType": "*Schema"},
        {"goIdent": "dynamic", "goType": "bool"},
        {"goIdent": "baseURI", "goType": "string"},
        {"goIdent": "resource", "goType": "*Schema"},
        {"goIdent": "anchors", "goType": "map[string]*Schema"},
        {"goIdent": "dynamicAnchors", "goType": "map[string]*Schema"},
        {"goIdent": "source", "goType": "[]byte"},
        {"goIdent": "skipValidation", "goType": "bool"}
      ],
      "fields": {
        "type": {"goType": "*any"}
      }
    }
  }
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/metawith

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

// The override file injects goAdditionalFields onto the meta-schema's
// composite root so the generated Schema struct carries the resolution
// metadata fields the package's existing Resolver expects to mutate.
// This is the load-bearing fixture for the eventual Phase 15 swap.
func TestSchema_HasResolutionMetadata(t *testing.T) {
	rt := reflect.TypeOf(Schema{})
	wantFields := map[string]string{
		"resolved":       "*model.Schema",
		"dynamic":        "bool",
		"baseURI":        "string",
		"resource":       "*model.Schema",
		"anchors":        "map[string]*model.Schema",
		"dynamicAnchors": "map[string]*model.Schema",
		"source":         "[]uint8",
		"skipValidation": "bool",
	}
	for name, wantType := range wantFields {
		f, ok := rt.FieldByName(name)
		if !ok {
			t.Errorf("Schema missing field %q", name)
			continue
		}
		if f.Type.String() != wantType {
			t.Errorf("Schema.%s type = %s, want %s", name, f.Type, wantType)
		}
		if got := f.Tag.Get("json"); got != "-" {
			t.Errorf("Schema.%s json tag = %q, want %q", name, got, "-")
		}
	}
}
